text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan

(Kawalan Hasil Penerbitan Tidak Diingini) (No. 11) 2015.

Larangan

2. Pencetakan, pengimportan, penghasilan, penghasilan semula, penerbitan,

penjualan, pengeluaran, pengelilingan, pengedaran atau pemilikan hasil penerbitan

yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual yang mungkin memudaratkan ketenteraman awam dan

yang mungkin menggemparkan fikiran orang ramai adalah dilarang secara mutlak di

seluruh Malaysia.

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(CONTROL OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) (NO. 11) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 7(1) of the Printing Presses and

Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Printing Presses and Publications

(Control of Undesirable Publications) (No. 11) Order 2015.

Prohibition

2. The printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of the publications described in the Schedule

which are likely to be prejudicial to public order and likely to alarm public opinion are

absolutely prohibited throughout Malaysia.
